results.question: Can I change my credit card statement date?
results.answer: Yes — you can change your statement date through a service request in the app; the new cycle takes effect from the next statement and the due date moves with it [KB-C-01]. The statement that bridges the change may be shorter or longer than usual [KB-C-01]. Would you like me to raise the request to change the statement date for your card ending 4417?

results.question: I want to close my credit card. How long will it take?
results.answer: You can close your card ending 4417 once all dues are paid; closure can be requested in the app, by email or by phone [KB-C-03]. The bank completes closure within 7 working days, otherwise it pays a penalty of Rs 500 per day of delay until the account is closed [KB-C-03]. Redeem any unused reward points before closing the card [KB-C-03].
